note:
Should be plus 1
The word is Κα (drop cap Κ and vowel α)
Τε is the word. Interval is +1 (πεταστή)

This is two different notes with a ομαλον below it which is ties the two together, but is qualitatively/orthographic only. Technically i think it’s under the second. The first note is the oligon (up one) then the ison (stay the same)
This is an oligon with psifiston underneath. Psifiston is just orthographic and qualitative. Oligon should be +1
This is a αποστροφός with a klasma meaning interval -1 with an extra beat due to the klasma
This is an ison with gorgon underneath. Meaning the note is +0 and 1/2 a beat, and it steals a 1/2 beat from the previous note with the klasma which makes the previous note 1-1/2 beats

This is a petasti compound with a kentima meaning go up three. It also has a klasma below which means it is two beats. The red ajem on top turns the scale into harmonic meaning the zo gets flattened to be only 6 moria from ke and 12 from ni (ie one semitone from ke and two semitones (fullstep ) from ni)
Oligon with kentima on top like this is +3. Vareia underneath qualitative/orthographic only.
Petasti with klasma compound. Should be plus one beat
This is an oligon with psifiston underneath. Should be +1 interval
This is a oligon with a dipli. (Dipli only Usually at the end of phrases)
